column1: # Trailing clauses that decorate a job title without changing which role it
# names. Removing them lets an exact match reach the role underneath.
# Reviewed and source-controlled. This list is never extended from scraped
# text: a rule that grows by itself eventually deletes a functional word and
# silently changes which role an advert means.
# Only *trailing* clauses and whole parenthetical groups matching these
# patterns are removed. Arbitrary bracketed text is left alone -- "(.NET/C#)"
# is a technology qualifier and belongs to skills
